messages:
Maya R.: quick multi-pop perf sweep for new-7b-qt (int8) across H100/A100 + edge routing. posting p50/p95 + throughput (batch=1, seq=512).

Maya R.: H100 (int8) -- us-east p50 48ms p95 120ms, us-west p50 55ms p95 145ms, eu-west p50 62ms p95 160ms. throughput ~900 tok/s (single stream).

Maya R.: A100 (int8) -- us-east p50 70ms p95 200ms, us-west p50 78ms p95 220ms, eu-west p50 85ms p95 240ms. throughput ~600 tok/s.

Maya R.: kernel selection: fused_att_v2 on H100 gave the H100 numbers; fall back to generic attention kernel increases p95 ~30-40ms.

Maya R.: note: eu-west p95 inflated when requests routed via central proxy (extra hop). forcing local-pop routing cut eu-west p95 by ~14% on H100.

Sam I.: did you run with KV cache warm?

Maya R.: yes KV warm on all runs (1000 warm steps). cold-starts add ~40-60ms to p95 especially on A100. caching hit-rate reported ~88% across traces.

Leila P.: can we try prefix caching (edge) + persistent connection sticky routing? my quick test earlier shaved another 10-15% on p95 for eu-west.

Igor K.: Capacity note: with our target SLA p95 < 200ms for seq=512, one H100 (int8, fused_att_v2) can support ~350 qps; one A100 ~230 qps (numbers assume 80% KV hit and batch=1 steady load).

Igor K.: if we allow batching=2 throughput jumps ~1.7x but tail gets worse in eu-west unless we keep local routing. so tradeoff.

Maya R.: reproducible command I used:

```
./perf_scan --model new-7b-qt --quant int8 --gpu H100 --batch 1 --seq 512 --region eu-west --kernels fused_att_v2 --warm 1000
```

Maya R.: full csv and graphs uploaded to perf-dash: https://redwood.internal/perf/dashboards/7b-qt/multi-pop/1764501234 (contains p50/p95 breakdown by kernel and routing).

Sam I.: looks like immediate ops levers: 1) force local-pop routing for small reqs 2) enable fused kernel on H100 3) tune prefix cache TTL for eu-west traffic.

Leila P.: agree. also add a quick canary that denies central-proxy routing for <1k token requests to ensure tail stays low.

perf-bot: Uploaded artifacts: CSV (s3://perf-artifacts/1764501234/summary.csv), flamegraphs, and kernel traces.

Maya R.: next steps: run A/B canary for routing policy in eu-west tomorrow, and schedule a deeper quant sweep (int4 fallback) on H100 to check p95 impact. tagging @eng-platform for routing rollout plan. :rocket:

Sam I.: ack, will coordinate with eng-platform.

Leila P.: will add a short eval set to track quality regression vs int8->int4 if we go that route.

Igor K.: ping me if you want a quick capacity run on the dedicated cluster, I can spin replicas.

Maya R.: thanks folks, folding notes into the perf ticket: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-2145
